description: hiui-design 页面变体局部改造 contract。该文件不枚举页面调整类型，也不定义固定增强类型表；它只约束当基础典型页无法完整满足用户诉求时，如何把当前需求建模为相对基础模板的局部改造、如何生成，以及如何验收。design-restore 命中典型页但仍需贴稿偏离时，也必须沿用这份 contract，而不是退回自由手写页面。

preconditions: base page type must be explicit
page must preserve most characteristics of the base typical page
adjustment must stay inside controlled regions
adjustment must not rewrite shell ownership or primary workflow

fieldSemantics.allowedRegions: Describe the relative structural regions involved in the current request, not a pre-enumerated expansion dictionary.
fieldSemantics.forbiddenRegions: Describe the structures or ownership relations that must remain untouched for the current request.
fieldSemantics.insertPositionRule: Describe how the adjusted structure is positioned relative to the official base template.
fieldSemantics.structureSummary: Summarize the stable primary regions, their responsibilities, the reading flow, and the interaction ownership preserved by this local adjustment.
fieldSemantics.intentContract: Describe the mustHave and mustNotAdd structural facts that the generator and validators must preserve for the current request.
fieldSemantics.componentCompositionPlan: Map each adjusted region or interaction concern to approved managed primitives, HiUI5 components, or typical-page public capabilities. Page-level freehand component invention is forbidden.
fieldSemantics.visualOwnershipPlan: State which visual responsibilities are owned by managed primitives/components, which ones remain chart-theme-owned, and which page-local styles are limited to layout-only.
fieldSemantics.forbiddenPrimitiveSemantics: List native tags or page-local pseudo components that must not be used as semantic substitutes in the adjusted region, such as raw button/span/div-based card, tag, badge, or action semantics.

forbiddenEscapes: introduce non-HiUI5 base design tokens or visual component system
decisionContract.generationRule: Always start from the official base page template and only perform controlled local adjustments in allowed regions.
decisionContract.executionRule: When the current contract can be mapped to a stable controlled-region anchor, the generator should automatically apply the local adjustment to the base template. When no stable anchor exists, generation must stop instead of falling back to freehand rewriting.
decisionContract.designSystemRule: Adjusted regions must continue to prioritize HiUI5 and local-managed-runtime components, and must remain inside hiui-design visual/token constraints.
passCriteria: result still clearly belongs to the base page type
base shell and ownership are preserved
template-outside regions are composed from managed primitives instead of page-local invented semantics
adjusted regions remain inside HiUI5 design constraints
